# Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (wrong result or error)
- [ ] New layer, model, task, or dataset reader
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance
- [ ] Release preparation

## Numerical Validation

Name the reference the change follows (paper, dense formula, reference
implementation) and how the tests check it.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change, including invalid inputs
- [ ] Graph indices stay 1-based in every public interface
- [ ] No leakage between training and evaluation data
- [ ] NEWS.md updated for user-facing changes
- [ ] Roxygen and generated help pages are in sync
